step1_create_account.description: Create or login to Deriv account

step3_import_xml.description: Import this XML file into dbot.deriv.com

steps.step: Click on "New Strategy" or import option
Select "Import from XML" or similar option
The bot configuration will be loaded
Stop anytime using the stop button

important_notes.note1: Start with DEMO account to test first
important_notes.note5: Trading involves risk - never risk more than you can afford

adaptive_learning.description: Bot learns and improves from past trades

features.feature: Daily loss limits to protect capital
Position sizing based on account balance

issue1.problem: XML file not loading in dbot.deriv.com

solutions.solution: Clear browser cache and refresh page
Check XML file format is valid
Check confidence threshold is not too high
Ensure sufficient tick data is collected
Check browser console for error messages
Increase confidence threshold to reduce false signals
Collect more historical data before trading
Adjust indicator periods for current market
